$comment: T275 M10 exit-gate record. This is an ACCEPTANCE artifact, not a signed .gate/records HMAC gate. The originally-reported evidence-link blocker is closed in code for the Paperclip-fork contract: limited-agent route exposes and persists a safe DAAS evidence link, the mission adapter persists it, the UI renders it, and a non-secret DAAS-origin URL-safety contract is enforced in route parsing, server persistence, and UI render. Accepted handoffs without safe evidence fail closed. Focused tests passed for each. Verdict is PASS for the Paperclip-fork contract.
verdict_basis: evidence_link_route_exposure_implemented + evidence_link_persistence_implemented + non_secret_url_safety_enforced (route + server + UI) + focused_tests_passed + prior_GO_gates

fix_summary.scope: T275 evidence-link route exposure + capture/persistence + non-secret URL-safety contract + UI render contract; accepted DAAS handoffs without safe evidence fail closed and never receive DAAS-route provenance.
server_changes: daas-integrations.ts handoffMissionToDaas now parses a safe DAAS evidence link via parseDaasEvidenceUrl and the limited-agent route POST /api/integrations/paperclip/missions exposes it as evidenceUrl on accepted responses and persists it to the issue when issueId is supplied; accepted responses lacking safe evidence return daas_mission_evidence_required instead of 202.

readSafeEvidenceUrl hardened: a non-secret evidence link is an absolute http(s) URL from the expected DAAS origin with a bounded evidence/proof path, NO userinfo, NO query string, and NO fragment; fails closed on javascript:/file:/data:/relative/non-string, cross-origin, path-token, and userinfo/query/fragment-bearing URLs. Exported and reused for server persistence read-back.

PersistedDaasMissionState / DaasMissionAdapterDispatchResult carry evidenceUrl: string | null; parseDaasEvidenceUrl reads evidence_url/evidenceUrl, evidence.{link,url,href}, links.{evidence,evidence_url,evidenceUrl} at envelope and data levels.

postInfrastructureTicketToDaasAdapter requires a safe evidenceUrl before returning ok=true for routed_accepted; summarizeDaasMissionRouting -> buildDaasMissionExecutionState persist evidenceUrl into issue.executionState.daasMission, and buildDaasMissionExecutionState sets DAAS-route provenance only when missionId + routed_accepted + ok + readSafeEvidenceUrl(evidenceUrl) are all present.
ui_changes: ui/src/lib/daas-mission-output.ts normalizeEvidenceUrl hardened to the same non-secret contract (absolute http(s); no userinfo/query/fragment) so a tampered persisted state cannot render a sensitive-material-bearing link.
DaasMissionStatusCard.tsx renders the 'DAAS evidence' link from the persisted field; tests added for render-on-safe, no-render-on-none, and drop-on-unsafe.

blocker.summary: The acceptance clause 'limited agent receives a DAAS evidence link' is closed in code for the Paperclip-fork contract: the limited-agent route authenticates a scoped agent JWT, exposes a safe evidence link, the mission adapter persists it, the UI renders it, accepted handoffs without safe evidence fail closed, all under a non-secret URL-safety contract; focused tests passed for each.
original_root_cause: The limited-agent route (daas-integrations.ts handoffMissionToDaas) parsed only mission id/status and never returned a DAAS evidence link; the new evidence handling lived only in daas-mission-adapter.ts.
URL validation was scheme-only, so http(s) URLs with userinfo, query strings, or fragments would have passed (violating the no-sensitive-material invariant).
PersistedDaasMissionState had no evidenceUrl/evidence/links field originally; UI read evidence-url fields the backend never populated.
Earlier drafts used a synthetic placeholder URL, which is not acceptance proof.
resolution: daas-integrations.ts: handoffMissionToDaas parses a safe evidence link (parseDaasEvidenceUrl) and POST /api/integrations/paperclip/missions exposes it as evidenceUrl on accepted responses; accepted responses without safe evidence fail closed with daas_mission_evidence_required.

readSafeEvidenceUrl hardened and exported: absolute http(s) only, NO userinfo credentials, NO query string, NO fragment; fails closed otherwise. Reused by route parse, server persistence read-back (readDaasMissionState), and mirrored in UI normalizeEvidenceUrl.
evidenceUrl persisted via postInfrastructureTicketToDaasAdapter -> summarizeDaasMissionRouting -> buildDaasMissionExecutionState into issue.executionState.daasMission; re-validated on read.

Tests passed: route exposes evidenceUrl on accepted handoff, accepted handoffs without safe evidence fail closed, userinfo/query/fragment rejection (daas-mission-adapter.test.ts parseDaasEvidenceUrl block), persistence round-trip, and UI render/drop (DaasMissionStatusCard.test.tsx).
blocker.required_to_clear: Paperclip-fork contract is clear; validator GO remains required before merge.
